boundary: No product execution, source patch, test, gold change, network, credential, GPU or API operation.

historical_oracle.scope: Ten selected complete audit/facts files checked against unchanged historical index; no new Gate A or replay claim.

implementation_acceptance_still_required: If concretely approved, final product quality then fresh five-project Gate A and complete affected-command comparisons; this source review is not those gates.
method: Read-only Git identity/tree/blob commands and standard-library decoding of public fixed source bytes.
Compare working-file bytes separately; clean Git does not imply CRLF-byte identity.
Independently inspect container shapes and string membership, without executing setup files or importing upstream/product libraries.

preparatory_collection.note: An earlier successful source read prepared the collector; the final timed collection below additionally records exact container-key line references. It is not a separate product run.

proposed_boundary_reviewed.Pipfile: Only present packages/dev-packages container types; individual dependency values remain outside this slice.
proposed_boundary_reviewed.environment: Legacy null root retained; other roots must be mappings; present dependencies must be a list of strings/mappings; present pip member must be a string list. Other mapping keys/selectors are not judged.
proposed_boundary_reviewed.pyproject: Present project/tool/valid-tool.poetry must be tables; valid-project dependencies must be string arrays; optional-dependencies must be a table of string arrays; valid-poetry dependencies must be a table. Poetry dependency values are not judged.
proposed_boundary_reviewed.slice: D-M-S; finite successfully decoded declaration structure, not generic parser completeness
